segments.an4.160:1.1: “Sugato vā, bhikkhave, loke tiṭṭhamāno sugatavinayo vā tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
segments.an4.160:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
segments.an4.160:3.2: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
segments.an4.160:3.4: Evaṃ sugato vā, bhikkhave, loke tiṭṭhamāno sugatavinayo vā tadassa bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
segments.an4.160:4.1: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.an4.160:4.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū duggahitaṃ suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇanti dunnikkhittehi padabyañjanehi.
segments.an4.160:4.4: Dunnikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa atthopi dunnayo hoti.
segments.an4.160:4.5: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū dubbacā honti dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā akkhamā appadakkhiṇaggāhino anusāsaniṃ.
segments.an4.160:5.2: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te na sakkaccaṃ suttantaṃ paraṃ vācenti.
segments.an4.160:6.2: Tesaṃ accayena chinnamūlako suttanto hoti appaṭisaraṇo.
segments.an4.160:6.3: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, therā bhikkhū bāhulikā honti sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅgamā, paviveke nikkhittadhurā, na vīriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an4.160:7.3: Sāpi hoti bāhulikā sāthalikā, okkamane pubbaṅgamā, paviveke nikkhittadhurā, na vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an4.160:7.4: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:7.5: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattantī”ti.
segments.an4.160:8.1: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
segments.an4.160:8.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suggahitaṃ suttantaṃ pariyāpuṇanti sunikkhittehi padabyañjanehi.
segments.an4.160:8.4: Sunikkhittassa, bhikkhave, padabyañjanassa atthopi sunayo hoti.
segments.an4.160:8.5: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:9.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhū suvacā honti sovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā khamā padakkhiṇaggāhino anusāsaniṃ.
segments.an4.160:9.2: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:10.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te sakkaccaṃ suttantaṃ paraṃ vācenti.
segments.an4.160:10.2: Tesaṃ accayena nacchinnamūlako [acchinnamūlako (syā. kaṃ.) a. ni.5.156] suttanto hoti sappaṭisaraṇo.
segments.an4.160:10.3: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:11.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, therā bhikkhū na bāhulikā honti na sāthalikā, okkamane nikkhittadhurā, paviveke pubbaṅgamā, vīriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an4.160:11.3: Sāpi hoti na bāhulikā na sāthalikā, okkamane nikkhittadhurā, paviveke pubbaṅgamā, vīriyaṃ ārabhati appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
segments.an4.160:11.4: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati.
segments.an4.160:11.5: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantī”ti.

lines: Padabyañjanehīti ettha padameva atthassa byañjanato byañjananti vuttaṃ.
Atthopi dunnayo hotīti aṭṭhakathā nīharitvā kathetuṃ na sakkā hoti.
Okkamane pubbaṅgamāti pañca nīvaraṇāni avagamanato okkamananti vuccanti, tattha pubbaṅgamāti attho.
Iminā nayena pana sabbattha attho veditabbo.
Dasame vaḷañjentīti sajjhāyanti ceva vācuggataṃ karontā dhārenti ca.
Avigatataṇhatāya taṃ taṃ parikkhārajātaṃ bahumpi ādiyantīti bahulā, te eva bāhulikā yathā “venayiko”ti (ma. ni.1.246; a. ni.8.11; pārā.8).
Te pana yasmā paccayabahulabhāvā yuttappayuttā nāma honti, tasmā āha “paccayabāhullāya paṭipannā”ti.
Sithilaṃ gaṇhantīti sāthalikā, sikkhāya ādaragāravābhāvena sithilaṃ adaḷhaṃ gaṇhantīti attho.
Sithilanti ca bhāvanapuṃsakaniddeso, sithila-saddena vā samānatthassa sāthalasaddassa vasena sāthalikāti padasiddhi veditabbā.
